evals.prompt:
From: Marta Kowalczyk (marta@quarrylanestudio.example)
Subject: Charged twice this month??

Hi, I've just checked our business account and Tallyhop has taken GBP 48.00 twice on 3 November 2026, both payments show as completed, card ending 4417. We're on the Team plan and nobody changed anything. Can you refund the extra one please?

Also, our accountant needs a proper invoice with our company name and VAT number on it for these payments. Where do I get that?

Thanks, Marta (workspace owner, Quarry Lane Studio)
expectations: output.json category is billing and route_to is billing

reply.md says the duplicate GBP 48.00 charge has been passed to the billing team and that a refund reaches the card within 5 to 7 business days once issued, without saying the refund has already been made
reply.md tells the customer to add the company name and VAT number under Settings > Billing > Billing details and to download the invoice from Settings > Billing > Invoices
output.json sources include duplicate-charges.md and invoices-and-receipts.md and do not include timesheet-export.md

evals.prompt:
From: Tom Achebe (tom@northgate-joinery.example)
Subject: Xero?

Hello, does Tallyhop integrate with Xero? We'd like our invoices to go across automatically instead of re-typing them every Friday.

Tom
expectations: output.json answered_from_articles is "no" with an empty sources list, or "partly" with no claim anywhere that Tallyhop supports Xero
reply.md neither claims nor denies that Tallyhop integrates with Xero; it says the team will check and get back to Tom
output.json route_to is tier-2 or product
